items.source: Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
items.translation: 指示某些其他对象是否“等于”当前对象。如果另一个对象属于同一类，且所有记录组件均相等，则这两个对象相等。本记录类中的所有组件均使用 Objects::equals(Object,Object) 进行比较。

items.source: ids - IDs of the embeddings to get.
items.translation: ids - 要获取的嵌入项 ID。

items.source: where - Condition to filter results based on metadata values.
items.translation: where - 根据元数据值过滤结果的筛选条件。

items.source: limit - Limit on the number of collection embeddings to get.
items.translation: limit - 获取集合嵌入的最大数量限制。

items.source: offset - Offset on the embeddings to get.
items.translation: offset - 获取的嵌入偏移量。

items.source: include - A list of what to include in the results. Can contain "embeddings", "metadatas", "documents", "distances". Ids are always included. Defaults to [metadatas, documents, distances].
items.translation: include - 结果中包含内容的列表。可包含"embeddings"、"metadatas"、"documents"和"distances"。Ids 始终被包含。默认值为 [metadatas, documents, distances]。
